verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs explicitly mention connecting to Slack, Linear, Figma, databases and extending capabilities 'with custom MCP tools', and separately reference provisioning MCP servers across an org — direct evidence of MCP client integration. However, the evidence is a single brief doc mention with no detailed setup guide, supported server list, or independent/hands-on confirmation of the feature working. Missing for 10: detailed MCP integration docs/tutorial, list of supported MCP servers, independent verification of the feature in practice.
